text:
Amy: Morning — planning a gradual routing policy change to steer EU->APAC regional edge for model-serving traffic today. Target start 2026-08-09T14:00Z. Will be a stepped shift, canary -> ramp -> observe.

Raj: Ack. Who's running the change and where will the commands run from? I can be on watch for infra alarms.

Maya: I can run it from my workstation. I'll execute the route policy swap via the control plane (rdrctl). ETA: logon at 13:50Z, start at 14:00Z.

Amy: Thanks. Plan: 1% at t=0 (10m), 5% at t=10m (10m), 15% at t=20m (15m), 40% at t=35m (10m), then 100% at t=45m if all good. If any step breaches health gates -> immediate rollback to previous weight.

Sam: Quick checklist for watchers:
- p50 latency (edge) < 180ms
- error rate < 0.5%
- 5xx count delta < 10 over baseline
- KV-cache hit rate within typical band
If any of the above trips, ping #eng-oncall + me.

Raj: I'll pre-open the pager window and keep traces ready. Also will monitor routing metrics in the console per-route dashboard and the region health probe.

Maya: Commands I'll run (copying here):
```
# set canary weight for apac on policy 'edge-routing-v7'
rdrctl policy set-weight --policy edge-routing-v7 --region apac --weight 1 --reason "gradual tilt 2026-08-09"
# later steps: 5,15,40,100
```
Rollback command: `rdrctl policy set-weight --policy edge-routing-v7 --region apac --weight 0 --reason rollback`

Amy: DNS TTL already reduced to 60s in the config? We don't want lingering DNS caches for the slow path.

Raj: Confirmed TTL=60 since 13:20Z. Also pre-warmed a fallback route group in case of capacity issues.

deploy-bot: [automated] policy edge-routing-v7 snapshot created by Maya at 2026-08-09T13:48:10Z (id: snap-20260809-134810).

Maya: I'll kick off step 0 at 14:00Z and post each weight change into this thread. Please react with :thumbsup: once you see the metrics are stable for that step.

Sam: I'll be watching logs and the smoke probe. If anything looks off I'll call rollback and ping infra.

Raj: Heads-up: I'll disable the heavier non-critical background jobs in EU for the first 30m to reduce noise.

Amy: Outstanding: Maya (executor), Raj (infra watch), Sam (oncall), Amy (product preside). Any objections?

Maya: No objections. Starting auth + ssh checks now.

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight checks: routing config valid, capacity estimate OK, no active incidents.

Maya: 14:00Z — setting apac weight to 1% now.

Raj: Seeing initial traffic and latency looks normal. p50=160ms, errors=0.12%, no new 5xxs.

Sam: Smoke probe passed (3/3) from apac edge endpoints. :white_check_mark:

Amy: Good. Proceed to 5% at 14:10Z if everyone stays green.

Maya: Will update at each step. If anything fails I'll run the rollback command and note reason here.

Raj: I'll keep a 30-minute post-rollout watch window after 100% completion.

Maya: (after) 14:55Z — reached 100% traffic. No anomalies in 45m ramp. Closing the rollout and leaving the snapshot.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout complete — policy edge-routing-v7 applied region=apac weight=100% by Maya at 2026-08-09T14:55:23Z (rollout-id: rlt-98765).

Amy: Thanks team — leaving a short follow-up doc in the runbook with metrics and timings.

Sam: Thanks all. I'll file a quick post-check note in the incidentless-rollouts board.
